evidence.text: Relic: Starfall Long Rifle - Aeldari; Availability: Near-Unique; Effect: 1d10 piercing; 180/720 ft; Accurate, Silent, Monomolecular, Reload 6. If you are Hidden and did not move this turn, attacks with it score a critical hit on 19-20. Once per short rest, ignore Heavy Cover on one attack.
